Good morning, Tamarack!

This is Joe with the Tamarack Ski Patrol.   0" of new snow was received overnight. Although we have a little bit of warmer days, the next few nights still look cold enough to keep our snow guns running and making snow! Keep those skis, fingers, and toes crossed! Opening day is growing closer but is still a moving target per incoming weather and snow.  Our Snowmaking Crew is doing everything they can to get us out there.

 

In the meantime, Outfitters is open and ready to help get your tickets/ passes, skis, snowboards, and boots primed and ready to rip. Our Village is also open with our award-winning restauraunts and shopping; from swag to outdoor gear, we've got what you need. Oh and don't miss seeing our 50 ft christmas tree near our Sports School!

 

Pray for snow!

See you SOON!
